youtube.baslik: Is the patient left without a hearing aid during repair? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: In Türkiye, hearing aid centers are governed by the 2011 Regulation on Custom-Made Prosthesis and Orthosis Centers and Hearing Aid Centers. Under Article 19, a device found nonconforming is repaired or replaced free of charge, and the center must provide the patient with a hearing aid during the repair or replacement period; under Article 15, records, registers and files are kept for five years. This is not legal advice; check the current legislation.
